audit.prepared: RootFirstStagePolicyCompiler and v63 prepared authority base deliberately keep authority maps and service rows empty. EnrollmentReceipt and PreparedNativeBundle do not prove active enrollment.
audit.producer: Existing RootPreparedNativeServiceGenerationProducer.build_selected produces exactly one selected worker service/process/network/active-network/runtime row from retained signed recipe and materialization. It requires a root factory base_policy containing the selected process profile; empty prepared base cannot supply it.
audit.parser: Existing _parse_protected_enrollment_document requires nonempty list principals/rules and list process_profiles plus Authentik policy. A local-owner selection is a distinct identity domain; fabricated Authentik values or treating prepared map schema as active list schema are prohibited.
audit.cycle: Current activate_runnable resolves compiled active policy before rendering its generation; active compiler now needs that rendered generation before publishing. Extract pure root rendering from activation; never publish to obtain inputs needed by the same publication.

producer_api.verify: RootActiveAuthorityProjectionRegistry.verify_current(projection) -> same projection, exact type + issuer object + retained identity and current dependency checks; equality-only DTO copies rejected.
producer_api.read: RootActiveAuthorityProjectionRegistry.read_current_authority_core(projection) -> bytes; root-private compiler API; verify before/after render/read; no public raw-byte input.
producer_api.activation: RootSetupPolicyFactory renders one aggregate generation before publication without enrollment CAS, service startup or authority socket issuance. activate_runnable consumes the same retained projection after publication claim binding and supplies the exact validated policy to existing enrollment CAS. No second random generation or second independent policy render.

UID/GID/user belong to isolated service NSS identity; Linux login-owner UID is identity evidence and is not substituted for worker UID. Resolve roots through existing held service-root receipts, no inferred filesystem paths.
assembly.principal: Bind principal.principal_binding to actual selected service UID, service_profile_id and namespace. Selected capability ceiling intersects actual current selected effect enrollments; source-home count/name does not grant capabilities. Actual identity fields from retained observer; no guessed email/subject/actor credential.
assembly.process_profile: Derive exact existing 16-field process record from current service row plus selected worker recipe/materialization: profile_id=actual recipe.process_profile_id; owner_uid/gid/user=actual service NSS; executable/artifact_sha256=actual materialized PM executable; artifact_root=held materialized runtime root; data_root=held service data root; generation=recipe.profile_generation; argv_recipe=[actual executable,*reviewed start argv suffix]; child_artifact_refs=exact selected runtime/native CAS closure; limits copied from reviewed selected service recipe. Validate recipe, PM and source closure before existing five-catalog producer. No placeholder process template.
assembly.five_catalogs: Call existing RootPreparedNativeServiceGenerationProducer.build_selected with this root-rendered typed base policy and exact selected_worker_recipe_handles/current native selection. Retain returned DTO. Replace selected worker service/profile rows using existing exact join rules. Preserve independent profile/service vs container generation domains.
assembly.catalogs: Render all schema-required service_generations keys through the installed validator. Native packages/actions/registrations/workflows/source issuers/schemas/resource backends/body recipes/controller roles come only from corresponding current sealed source preparation and assembly receipts. Source package/member paths are those retained by verified full source/output member receipts, never documentation paths or artifact archive hash as executable hash. Every selected capability needs its actual prerequisite; absent unselected capabilities have exact empty catalogs. Duplicate/conflicting row IDs or unverifiable selected sources deny entire compilation.
assembly.effect_rules: Project exact {capability,operation,target,recipient} from current issuer-retained effect enrollment records. No synthetic process.start rule inferred from artifact existence; selected source role/process operation recipes and native child grant policy must supply actual reviewed effect enrollment. Effect authorizer selection and data/privacy/budget policy remain separate and must join exact recipients/targets.
assembly.identity_domain: Authentik mode serializes actual current enrolled identity and policy references through existing strict parser. Local-owner mode needs a closed local-owner policy projection and matching strict load_published_protected_enrollment branch built from actual selected capability ceiling/local effect enrollments. Use existing local-owner runtime policy adapter if source-verified; if absent, implement finite adapter and strict schema under HI-T231.1, or report exact missing producer. Never fabricate Authentik base_url/group/subject/directory refs, relax Authentik parser, or silently switch mode. Local mode does not enroll homelab/admin/provider/account authority.
assembly.optional_remote: No selected remote choice => v225 remote_service_identity_source_records empty and its optional member absent/null SHA/size zero; no remote prerequisite. Selected remote choice => exact RootSelectedRemoteServiceIdentityRegistry.prepare_publication_source(role_handles, remote_source_inputs: RootSelectedRemoteStartupSourceInputs) -> RootPreparedRemoteIdentityPublicationSource, only after genuine three-role owned NSS/source/build terminal/CAS/package/executable/materialized runtime proof. This API is specified in v225, not implemented proof; RootSelectedRemoteRuntimeBuildSelection tuple is NOT completed aggregate. Apply v225 schema3 remote identity catalog extension using strict installed validator; selected incomplete source remains pending. No fabricated getter, row or silent omission.

Exact same 208 current home source set/PM/principal/namespace/closure lineage retained by aggregate and compiler; no 207 fabricated service enrollments or future task fields.

digest_domains.canonical: UTF-8 JSON(sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False), no newline, duplicate keys rejected, deterministic bounded row order by catalog ID and native manifest rules.
digest_domains.service_generation: SHA256 canonical entire service_generations object excluding only generation_digest; no enclosing digest embedded in its own rows.
digest_domains.projection: SHA256 canonical explicit DTO public input joins (schema/session/transaction/plan/prepared generation/reservation/output closure/active generation/identity and sorted exact source receipt IDs plus their observed digests). Exclude projection_sha256, core bytes/hash/size, final publication claim digest, seals/FDs/monotonic values.
digest_domains.core: authority_core_sha256=SHA256 actual canonical core bytes; size=len(bytes); schema=parsed schema. Container generation hash, executable SHA, source archive SHA, native closure SHA, crosswalk SHA and compiler claim digest remain separate.
digest_domains.claim: Compiler derives exact core bytes/SHA/size/schema from current sealed aggregate read; manifest/descriptor/signed receipt bind same core and separate crosswalk. Final source_output_claim_sha256 is postcompile getter-only per v215, never input to own aggregate/core.

lifetime.currentness: Every resolve/read/compile/retry revalidates original setup session/controller deadline, authorization transaction, prepared CAS, installed release module/member custody, source-choice epochs/revocation, adopted principal/namespace, NSS identity/roots, PM/materialization complete closure, exact five CAS outputs/reservation/roles, native generation and home sources. Changed dependency invalidates cached aggregate and claims; no TTL-only authority.
lifetime.retry: Unchanged reservation returns identical bytes/generation. Failure before publication leaves prepared state intact and no runtime activation. Published claim retry uses exact retained aggregate; changed inputs require normal new selection/precompile path with existing rollback/journal rules.
lifetime.restart: Never reconstruct setup DTO seal from journal JSON. Published core loads through held nofollow publisher member and current descriptor/signed receipt/claim/committed CAS. Existing v221 PM resolver recreates actual fresh runtime proof from committed source, not expired setup receipt.

failure_tests: Positive actual temporary isolated source/NSS/PM/native-output/home-source assembly -> retained aggregate -> compiler -> publication -> exact published reader -> same generation enrollment; no monkeypatched currentness callback or invented core bytes as positive proof.
Empty prepared base remains empty and cannot be issued/read as active; validate activation sideeffects absent during pure render.

Copied DTO/foreign issuer/session/reservation, wrong NSS, changed root inode, PM executable/full closure mismatch, any missing five CAS role, tampered native member => no claim/publication/runtime start.
Changed choice/revocation/controller/original deadline/source epoch or expired minimum lease during rendering/readback => fail with pending producer identity.

All schema required catalogs and complete generation hash validated; duplicate/conflicting source role/effect/backend/recipient/service joins fail; source archive SHA cannot satisfy executable hash.

Absent optional remote succeeds with empty remote catalogs; selected incomplete remote fails, selected genuine remote binds complete existing v225 producer.
Identical retry returns exact bytes/generation; failed CAS and rollback preserve prepared/data/credentials; restart held core tamper/stale pointer denied and refreshed PM proof required.
